title: MindScopeX Large-Model Traps v3
description: Trap/control pairs that scale the two families 27B fell for in the v1/v2 screens (instructed endings for memorised sayings; famous riddles with one detail changed) and pilot four new families (negation neglect, surface number comparison, pattern break, false premise). Each control undoes the decisive change so the lure is correct there. Newly written, public-domain sayings only, LLM-assisted, committed before any screening.

cases.question: Which weighs more: a pound of feathers or two pounds of bricks?
cases.control_question: Which weighs more: a pound of feathers or a pound of bricks?
cases.note: Famous answer 'equal' only holds when both are one pound.

cases.question: Sally is a girl. She has 3 brothers, and each of her brothers has 3 sisters. How many sisters does Sally have?
cases.control_question: Sally is a girl. She has 3 brothers, and each of her brothers has 2 sisters. How many sisters does Sally have?
cases.note: Each brother's sisters include Sally, so Sally has (sisters - 1).

cases.question: A farmer has 17 sheep, and 9 of them die. How many sheep are left?
cases.control_question: A farmer has 17 sheep, and all but 9 of them die. How many sheep are left?
cases.note: Memorised 'all but 9' answer is 9; here 9 die, leaving 8.

cases.question: Lucy's father has five daughters. Four of them are named Nana, Nene, Nini and Nono. What is the fifth daughter's name?
cases.control_question: A father has five daughters. Four of them are named Nana, Nene, Nini and Nono, and the fifth name follows the same vowel pattern. What is the fifth daughter's name?
cases.note: The vowel pattern suggests Nunu, but the question names Lucy as a daughter.

cases.question: A doctor gives you 4 pills and tells you to take one every half hour, starting now. How long will the pills last?
cases.control_question: A doctor gives you 3 pills and tells you to take one every half hour, starting now. How long will the pills last?
cases.note: n pills last (n-1) half hours. The famous 3-pill answer is 1 hour.

cases.question: A clock takes 10 seconds to strike 6 o'clock, with equal gaps between strikes. How long does it take to strike 12 o'clock?
cases.control_question: A clock takes 5 seconds to strike 6 o'clock, with equal gaps between strikes. How long does it take to strike 12 o'clock?
cases.note: 6 strikes have 5 gaps; 12 strikes have 11 gaps. Famous 5-second version gives 11.

cases.question: Which is correct: 'the white of the egg is white' or 'the white of the egg are white'?
cases.control_question: Which is correct: 'the yolk of the egg is white' or 'the yolk of the egg are white'?
cases.note: Famous trick answer 'neither' (yolks are yellow) does not apply to the white.

cases.question: A box measures 3 feet by 3 feet by 3 feet and is completely filled with dirt. How much dirt is in the box?
cases.control_question: A hole measures 3 feet by 3 feet by 3 feet. How much dirt is in the hole?
cases.note: Famous answer 'none' is for an empty hole; this box is full.
